server.description: Core server settings for bind address and connection handling.

bind_address.description: IP address the server listens on (e.g., '0.0.0.0' for all interfaces).

max_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous client connections allowed.

max_allowed_packet.description: Maximum size of a single packet or row (e.g., '64M', '256M').

timeout_connect.description: Seconds to wait for a connection handshake.

timeout_wait.description: Seconds to wait for activity on a connection (wait_timeout).

timeout_read.description: Seconds to wait for activity on a read operation (net_read_timeout).

timeout_write.description: Seconds to wait for activity on a write operation (net_write_timeout).

storage.description: InnoDB and general storage engine tuning.

innodb_buffer_pool_size.description: Size of memory buffer for caching InnoDB data and indexes (e.g., '256M', '2G').

innodb_log_file_size.description: Size of each InnoDB redo log file (larger improves write performance).

innodb_log_buffer_size.description: Size of buffer for InnoDB log writes before flushing to disk.

innodb_flush_method.description: How InnoDB flushes data and logs to disk (e.g., 'fsync', 'O_DIRECT').

data_directory.description: Absolute path to the MySQL data directory.

enabled.description: Enable binary logging for replication or point-in-time recovery.

log_bin.description: Base name/path for binary log files.

cert_path.description: Path to server SSL certificate file.

key_path.description: Path to server SSL private key file.

ca_path.description: Path to CA certificate for verifying clients.

charsets.description: Default character set and collation for new databases/tables.

general_log.description: Enable logging of all queries to the general log.

general_log_file.description: Path for general query log file (only if enabled).

slow_query_log_file.description: Path for slow query log file (only if enabled).

long_query_time.description: Query execution time (seconds) above which queries are considered slow.

max_heap_table_size.description: Maximum size of in-memory temporary tables.

tmp_table_size.description: Maximum size of in-memory temporary tables (same as max_heap_table_size recommended).

thread_cache_size.description: Number of threads to cache for reuse (reduces thread creation overhead).

join_buffer_size.description: Buffer size for JOIN operations without indexes.

sort_buffer_size.description: Buffer size for ORDER BY / GROUP BY operations.

read_buffer_size.description: Buffer size for sequential table scans.

read_rnd_buffer_size.description: Buffer size for random reads after sorting (e.g., ORDER BY).

defaults.description: Core defaults for storage engine and schema options.

default_storage_engine.description: Default storage engine for new tables (e.g., 'InnoDB', 'MyISAM').

skip_symbolic_links.description: Prevent symbolic links to data files (security hardening).

port.description: Default port for MySQL client connections.

socket.description: Default Unix socket path for local client connections.
